messages:
maya: Quick update — rolled tiered-kv-cache (smoothed-evict) to 15% canary across us and eu. small rollout, targeting multi-turn convo workloads. :sparkles:

infra-bot: Canary summary (45m):
```
model: redwood-v3-base
traffic: 15% canary
p50_before: 48ms
p50_after: 41ms
p95_before: 240ms
p95_after: 190ms
p99_before: 900ms
p99_after: 700ms
token_cost_before: $0.0072
token_cost_after: $0.0059
kv_hitrate_before: 22%
kv_hitrate_after: 39%
cpu_spike_events: 2 (node-17 eu-west)
error_rate: 0.015% -> 0.018%
```

chris: nice! what's the logic difference vs old prefix-store?
maya: tiered-kv keeps short prefixes in L1 (fast in-memory) and longer prefixes in L2 (compressed). smoothed-evict uses a decay window to avoid thrashing on prefix churn. less aggressive eviction for moderately-hot prefixes.

sam: rollout command plz
maya: `rcli rollout start --policy tiered-kv-cache --canary 15 --model redwood-v3-base --smooth-evict=0.6`

priya: config snippet:
```
tiered_kv_cache:
  enabled: true
  l1_max_entries: 200000
  l2_compression: zstd16
  smooth_evict_alpha: 0.6
  min_promote_len: 6
```

chris: memory impact?
maya: L1 memory +4% on canary hosts, L2 adds negligible disk. overall GPU recompute dropped, so net token compute down ~12%.

eng-sre: created follow-up ticket (INC-2033) for node-17 investigation; added temp alert for >3% error uplift during any canary.

sam: any Dedicated/private notes?
maya: for Dedicated set `node.bootstrap.runtime_flags=tiered_kv_cache=true` and ensure zstd codec present. on-prem: consider enabling zstd kernel accel or dedicate an SSD for L2 if throughput critical. recommend 5% internal canary first.

priya: timeline to 100%?
maya: if stable through long-tail QA tonight, promote to 40% Mon, then gradual to 100% by Fri. running semantic-eval and customer prompt holdouts overnight.

chris: can you prep a one-slide summary for ops sync? include cost per million tokens delta and p99 graphs.
maya: will share a short slide + raw metrics dashboard link in #eng-dashboards. thanks all! :slightly_smiling_face:
